title: Senior OutSystems Engineer
description:
Senior OutSystems Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.


This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.


What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Analista Linux Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes Linux em produção (alta disponibilidade e missão crítica);
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado de sistemas operacionais, redes e aplicações;
  • Gerenciar servidores físicos, virtuais e ambientes em cloud HP;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais utilizando Shell Script, Python, ansible ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de monitoramento (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.);
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos, garantindo rápida identificação de causa raiz;
  • Aplicar hardening e boas práticas de segurança em servidores Linux Red Hat Enterprise;
  • Gerenciar patches, atualizações e ciclo de vida dos sistemas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, redes, banco de dados e segurança;
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos e manter base de conhecimento atualizada via Gilab e Azure DevOps.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência com administração de sistemas Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.);
  • Conhecimento avançado em troubleshooting (CPU, memória, I/O, rede, processos);
  • Experiência com virtualização (VMware, KVM ou similares);
  • Domínio de linha de comando e scripting (Bash, Shell Script e ansible);
  • Conhecimento em redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, balanceamento);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento; Munin e Zabbix.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).

title: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)
description:
Role: Senior React Native Developer (Cross-Platform, Salesforce Mobile SDK)

Remote (Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico)

Contract


Role Purpose


As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyperscale heavy application landscape


Key Responsibilities


• Cross Platform Development Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native

• Salesforce Integration Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds

• Offline Data Management Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB Salesforce Smart Store and Smart Sync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization

• Computer Vision Integration Implement image processing and computer vision features eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment

• State Management Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit

• Experience Engineering Build high-fidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for field force users and consumers adhering to global brand standards

• Version Control CICD Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines

• Emerging Tech Pilots Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scale hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI

• Senior Developer Specifics Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews optimize app performance memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

• Core Framework Expertlevel proficiency in React Native JavaScript TypeScript

• Salesforce Mobile Handson experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB

• State Management Deep understanding of Redux for enterprise scale mobile apps

• Computer Vision Experience integrating OpenCV or similar C Native modules into React Native applications

• Version Control Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Git based collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

• Native Modules Ability to write Native Bridges in Swift Objective C iOS or Java Kotlin Android

• Hyper scaler Exposure Experience connecting mobile apps to GCP Azure backend services Cloud Run App Services

• Salesforce Platform Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC

• Mobile Security Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns

• FMCG Domain Understanding of retail execution van sales or field force automation workflows


Apply or send your resume to

title: Risk Control Specialist (UTC+8 Night shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Estamos em busca de Vendedores(as) para atuar em concessionárias parceiras em diversas regiões do Brasil . A oportunidade é ideal para profissionais com perfil comercial, foco em resultados e interesse em crescimento no segmento de consórcios.

A contratação é realizada diretamente pela concessionária, podendo ocorrer nos modelos CLT ou PJ , e também de forma Presencial ou Hibrida, conforme a operação local, com possibilidade de ganhos escaláveis conforme performance.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar com vendas exclusivas de consórcio ;
  • Realizar atendimento presencial e digital (WhatsApp, telefone e canais online);
  • Trabalhar com leads fornecidos pela loja e realizar prospecção ativa ;
  • Apresentar e simular planos de consórcio, conduzindo o processo comercial até o fechamento;
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o funil de vendas , garantindo follow-up e conversão;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com clientes e parceiros internos;
  • Registrar atendimentos e vendas nos sistemas internos.

✨ Buscamos profissionais que:

  • Tenham perfil comercial e foco em resultados;
  • Gostem de atendimento ao cliente e negociação;
  • Sejam organizados, proativos e orientados a metas;
  • Queiram crescer profissionalmente no segmento de consórcios.

Vagas disponíveis em diferentes cidades e estados do Brasil.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Atuação em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com foco em soluções inovadoras baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e evolução contínua de produtos digitais.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais de soluções com uso de IA;
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em especificações claras, fluxos e critérios de aceite;
  • Apoiar o desenho de jornadas, regras de negócio e casos de uso;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, tecnologia, UX e operação;
  • Participar da validação de entregas, testes funcionais e processos de homologação;
  • Documentar processos, fluxos, funcionalidades e regras associadas às soluções;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de backlog e priorização de demandas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e experiências apoiadas por IA;
  • Contribuir com a evolução contínua das soluções em produção.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com LLMs, chatbots ou agentes inteligentes;
  • Conhecimento em fluxos conversacionais;
  • Noções de APIs, automações e integrações;
  • Experiência com testes de IA e análise de respostas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence, Miro ou Figma;
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud como Google Cloud e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em Databricks.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) / Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Important:

We need a senior-level engineer with recent hands-on experience in Node.js and strong expertise in MongoDB, TypeScript, SQL, AWS, and API development .

Experience with GraphQL is a plus .


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled backend/data engineer with strong experience in building scalable APIs and working with complex data systems.

This role focuses on Node.js, TypeScript, backend architecture, and data modeling , with exposure to cloud-native and event-driven systems .


Responsibilities

• Build and maintain scalable APIs (REST & GraphQL) for high-performance applications

• Design and optimize data models using MongoDB, NoSQL, and relational databases

• Implement schema design, indexing strategies, and transactions for performance and scalability

• Develop and maintain ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows

• Collaborate on backend architecture , including microservices and distributed systems

• Work with cloud platforms (AWS/OCI) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Ensure code quality, testing, and best engineering practices across the development lifecycle


Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript (recent projects required)

• Expertise in MongoDB and database modeling (NoSQL + SQL)

• Solid experience building REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus)

• Strong understanding of software engineering principles (SOLID, clean architecture, design patterns)

• Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, etc.) or OCI

• Experience with containers (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have

• Experience with GraphQL APIs

• Messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS/SNS

• Experience with event-driven architecture

• Exposure to serverless architectures

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, etc.)

title: Analista de IA e Automações
description:
A Blocks está buscando uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de IA e Automações , com foco em aplicar inteligência artificial de forma prática nos processos internos da empresa. Buscamos alguém que não apenas use ferramentas de IA, mas que saiba conectar diferentes ferramentas à IA via MCP para criar fluxos de trabalho que melhorem processos reais dentro da empresa . Essa pessoa precisa gostar de investigar problemas, conversar com diferentes times, entender gargalos, testar soluções, criar automações e acompanhar se essas soluções estão realmente gerando resultados.


Sobre a Blocks

A Blocks é uma empresa de tecnologia, possui um software próprio e se dedica a digitalizar produtos reais em modelos 3D de alta qualidade, fornecendo ferramentas essenciais para otimizar os processos de trabalho de arquitetos, engenheiros e designers de interiores ao redor do mundo.


O que esperamos de você

  • Mapear processos internos dos diferentes times da Blocks e identificar oportunidades de otimização com IA.
  • Acompanhar como as equipes estão utilizando ferramentas de inteligência artificial no dia a dia.
  • Propor, testar e implementar novos fluxos de trabalho com IA.
  • Criar automações utilizando n8n, APIs, webhooks e integrações entre sistemas.
  • Configurar agentes de IA para tarefas específicas da empresa.
  • Implementar integrações com ferramentas externas utilizando MCP — Model Context Protocol.
  • Conectar modelos de IA a sistemas internos, documentos, bases de dados, planilhas, CRMs, plataformas de atendimento, APIs e outras ferramentas utilizadas pela empresa.
  • Criar e organizar prompts, workflows e processos padronizados para uso interno.
  • Treinar e orientar os times sobre boas práticas no uso de IA.
  • Documentar fluxos, integrações, automações e processos implementados.
  • Medir resultados e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos automatizados.
  • Pesquisar novas ferramentas de IA e avaliar sua aplicação prática na empresa.

title: Analista de Política de Crédito SR - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Principais desafios

Conduzir estudos estratégicos para identificar dores de mercado relacionadas às etapas de atraso e oportunidades de otimização nos processos de cobrança, considerando buckets de atraso curto, médio e longo.

Aplicar soluções analíticas avançadas para análise de dados e geração de insights que aprimorem políticas de cobrança e estratégias de gerenciamento de risco.

Desenvolver e executar estratégias analíticas que apoiem a tomada de decisão ao longo de todo o ciclo de crédito, desde a avaliação de risco até a gestão de cobranças.

Demonstrar aos stakeholders a eficiência e impacto das soluções analíticas na gestão do ciclo de crédito.

Colaborar com equipes internas como Data Science, Plataformas, Vendas e Operações para evolução contínua das estratégias de cobrança.


Experiência necessária

Experiência comprovada em análise de dados aplicada a processos de cobrança, gerenciamento de risco ou ciência de dados.

Experiência com políticas de cobrança e estratégias de recuperação de crédito.

Capacidade de compreender necessidades de negócio e traduzi-las em insights analíticos aplicáveis ao ciclo de crédito.

Forte domínio em análise de dados, estatística e ferramentas de visualização, especialmente aplicadas ao contexto financeiro.

Experiência em políticas de desconto, cessão e precificação de carteiras de atraso (curto e longo prazo).

Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.


Hard Skills

BigQuery SQL – nível sênior

Python – nível sênior

Análise estatística e modelagem de dados

Manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados

Visualização de dados aplicada a crédito e cobrança


Domínios de Negócio

Gerenciamento de Risco (Avançado)

Políticas de Cobrança (Avançado)

Ciclo de Crédito


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer


We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Location : Remote, open to candidates based in Brazil and the Philippines.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion.
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks, voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning, GANs, or edge AI deployments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - AWS
description:
Banco de Talentos – Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior AWS.


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos inovação, colaboração, desenvolvimento contínuo e qualidade de vida , com incentivos voltados para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto de tecnologia , junto a um de nossos clientes estratégicos, com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack , por meio de contrato no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) . A atuação será remota , com foco em desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações.


Perfil técnico esperado:

• Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask) .
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito .
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.

• Frontend

  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces ricas e interativas utilizando React e Next.js .
  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts .
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.

• Conhecimentos gerais

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript .
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git ).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban .


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com AWS Lake Formation e/ou Amazon Redshift .
  • Conhecimento em Strapi CMS .
  • Vivência com outras bibliotecas de visualização de dados (D3.js, Plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e).


Escopo de atuação:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções Full Stack conforme escopo definido do projeto.
  • Definição e sustentação da arquitetura técnica das aplicações.
  • Análise e otimização de performance e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Apoio técnico e orientação a profissionais com menor senioridade no contexto do projeto.
  • Contribuição na definição de padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Produção de documentação técnica e apoio à transferência de conhecimento.

Banco de Talentos – Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior AWS.


Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos inovação, colaboração, desenvolvimento contínuo e qualidade de vida , com incentivos voltados para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuação em projeto de tecnologia , junto a um de nossos clientes estratégicos, com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack , por meio de contrato no modelo Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) . A atuação será remota , com foco em desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações.


Perfil técnico esperado:

• Backend

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL utilizando Python (Flask) .
  • Integração de APIs com AWS Lake Formation e Amazon Redshift para processamento e consulta de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Implementação de regras de negócio e controle de acesso com AWS Cognito .
  • Atuação com AWS Lambda e API Gateway em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade em APIs.

• Frontend

  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces ricas e interativas utilizando React e Next.js .
  • Criação de dashboards e visualizações de dados com bibliotecas como Nivo ou Recharts .
  • Integração do frontend com AWS Cognito para autenticação e gestão de sessões.
  • Consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.
  • Garantia de responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos.

• Conhecimentos gerais

  • Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript .
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git ).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e conceitos de Data Warehouse / Lakehouse (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Vivência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito e Amplify .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban .


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com AWS Lake Formation e/ou Amazon Redshift .
  • Conhecimento em Strapi CMS .
  • Vivência com outras bibliotecas de visualização de dados (D3.js, Plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e).


Escopo de atuação:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções Full Stack conforme escopo definido do projeto.
  • Definição e sustentação da arquitetura técnica das aplicações.
  • Análise e otimização de performance e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Apoio técnico e orientação a profissionais com menor senioridade no contexto do projeto.
  • Contribuição na definição de padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Produção de documentação técnica e apoio à transferência de conhecimento.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Designer Gráfico Freelancer (PJ) | Diagramação de Materiais Corporativos
description:
Designer Gráfico Freelancer (PJ) | Diagramação de Materiais Corporativos

Remoto | Projeto estruturado | Início imediato


A Dream Success busca prestador de serviço (PJ/freelancer) para execução de Projeto de Diagramação Temporário. Com foco na estruturação de materiais de consultoria com padrão corporativo, via CanvaPro e Pacote Adobe.


Este não é um projeto de criação livre e sim de execução operacional. Buscamos profissionais (ou empresas) com capacidade comprovada de execução técnica, padronização e produção em escala.



Escopo da Prestação de Serviço

  • Diagramação de material principal (~300 páginas);
  • Aplicação rigorosa do brand kit;
  • Organização visual de conteúdo previamente estruturado;
  • Desenvolvimento de materiais complementares, como Canva Packs (nível profissional, do zero), Propostas gráficas e Materiais vinculados ao conteúdo principal;
  • O foco está em materiais com padrão corporativo, não sendo o objetivo estilos ilustrativos, autorais ou caricatos.



Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Domínio avançado real de Canva Pro;
  • Domínio do Pacote Adobe (uso profissional);
  • Experiência comprovada em diagramação de books, relatórios ou materiais corporativos extensos;
  • Estruturação visual com foco em leitura e hierarquia de informação;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver Canva Packs do zero (não adaptados).


É obrigatório que o prestador possua licenças ativas e próprias das ferramentas (Canva Pro e Adobe).



Modelo de Prestação de Serviço

  • Contratação como pessoa jurídica (PJ) / freelancer;
  • Remuneração por hora efetivamente trabalhada - R$ 16,25 por hora com referência de até R$ 650 semanais;
  • A execução das horas ocorre com autonomia de organização, sem exigência de horário fixo, com expectativa de disponibilidade de até 40 horas semanais dedicadas ao projeto;
  • Durante o período de execução das horas registradas, é esperado foco integral na prestação do serviço. Não sendo compatível a execução simultânea de outras atividades durante o período registrado;
  • A Dream Success disponibiliza ao prestador a ferramenta de acompanhamento de produtividade (Jibble), que realiza registro de horas trabalhadas e monitoramento da atividade remota durante o período de execução.


Ao se candidatar, o prestador declara estar ciente e de acordo com:

  • O uso da ferramenta durante a prestação do serviço;
  • O monitoramento integral das horas registradas;
  • As diretrizes aplicáveis de proteção de dados (LGPD).



Fluxo de Avaliação

Nosso processo de avaliação é estruturado para garantir, de forma objetiva, a validação da capacidade técnica e da aderência ao tipo de entrega exigida pelo projeto. As etapas abaixo seguem uma lógica sequencial de profundidade, iniciando pela análise prática e avançando para validação de contexto e execução.


  • Envio obrigatório de portfólio em PDF: O portfólio deve ser anexado diretamente na candidatura via LinkedIn e precisa conter, obrigatoriamente, materiais alinhados ao escopo do projeto, como books, relatórios, apresentações estruturadas ou documentos corporativos extensos. Portfólios com foco em peças criativas, redes sociais ou materiais desalinhados ao contexto não serão considerados.Candidaturas sem portfólio no formato solicitado serão desclassificadas automaticamente.
  • Vídeo de apresentação: Após a triagem inicial, os profissionais selecionados serão convidados a gravar um vídeo de apresentação. O objetivo desta etapa é aprofundar o entendimento sobre sua experiência prática, validar sua participação real nos projetos apresentados e esclarecer eventuais pontos do portfólio.
  • Entrevista com o gestor do projeto: Etapa focada na validação técnica mais aprofundada e no alinhamento sobre padrão de entrega, dinâmica de execução e expectativa de performance dentro do projeto.
  • Início imediato: Profissionais aprovados seguem para início imediato da prestação de serviço.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Java / AI-Enabled)

Rocket Financial builds innovative fintech products that improve how money moves globally. We work across multiple high-impact fintech projects , tackling complex problems in payments, infrastructure, and financial services.


We are a U.S.-based company hiring an international contractor located in Brazil . This role will work closely with a distributed team, including Brazil and Canada based engineers.


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is primarily backend-focused but comfortable contributing to the frontend when needed. You’ll play a key role in shaping systems, building scalable applications, and leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter.


WHY JOIN US

  • Fast-paced startup environment with high impact and real ownership
  • 100% fully remote role
  • Work with a U.S.-based company building cutting-edge fintech products
  • Flexible schedule with alignment to East Coast hours
  • Collaborative, international team with strong engineering talent
  • Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven development


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and scale Java-based backend systems and microservices
  • Contribute to frontend features (React or similar) when needed
  • Design robust, scalable applications and system architectures
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development and problem-solving
  • Write and refine effective AI prompts for engineering workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile processes
  • Debug and resolve production issues and performance challenges


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience (strong backend focus in Java)
  • Experience with Spring, microservices, and REST APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack (React/TypeScript or similar )
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and AWS
  • Able to thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt quickly

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: ZScaler Engineer
description:
We are seeking a ZTNA Operations Support Engineer to join our Network Security Operations team. This role is primarily focused on the day-to-day operation, monitoring, and support of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services.


You will be responsible for ensuring reliable and secure user access, handling incidents, and maintaining operational excellence across our Zero Trust environment. This position is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in support, troubleshooting, and service operations within secure access platforms (ZTNA, VPN, or SSE) using Zscaler.


Key Responsibilities


- Provide L3 operational support for the ZTNA platform.

- Handle incident, request, and problem management through ticketing systems.

- Troubleshoot and resolve:

 - User access and connectivity issues

 - Authentication and SSO-related problems

 - Application access failures and latency complaints

- Perform initial triage, impact assessment, and escalation when required.

- Monitor platform health, alerts, and dashboards to ensure service availability.

- Execute standard operational changes (policy updates, user onboarding/offboarding, access adjustments).

- Maintain and follow runbooks, SOPs, and escalation procedures.

- Support major incident management (MIM) and post-incident reviews (RCA support).

- Work closely with engineering teams for issue handoff and permanent fixes.

- Contribute to continuous service improvement and operational efficiency.


Required Qualifications


- Experience in network/security operations or technical support roles.

- Hands-on experience with ZTNA, VPN, or remote access solutions.

- Familiarity with at least one major vendor platform (Zscaler, preferred, but not exclusively).

- Strong understanding of:

 - TCP/IP, DNS, and basic network troubleshooting

 - Authentication flows (SSO, MFA, SAML, OIDC)

- Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).

- Ability to analyze logs and identify root causes of common issues.


Preferred Qualifications


- Experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) or Network Operations Center (NOC) environments.

- Exposure to SSE/SASE environments.

- Familiarity with endpoint posture, device compliance, and access policies.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments.


Soft Skills


- Strong customer support mindset with clear communication skills.

- Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tickets under SLA pressure.

- Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits.

- Team player with a proactive approach to operational stability.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (L3) - Healthcare Tech Nonprofit


Want your code to actually matter?

We're hiring on behalf of a mission-driven healthcare technology nonprofit whose platform has reached tens of millions of patients in low-income communities across the US. They're growing the team that builds the SaaS product hundreds of safety-net clinics rely on every day to manage patients and run patient engagement programs.


This is a senior IC role with shared team-lead responsibilities - owning complex full-stack features end-to-end, mentoring mid-level engineers, and shaping architecture across a Rails monolith and React SPA.


The Stack Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud · Sidekiq


What You'll Own

  • Driving the technical direction of key Applications platform features
  • Shipping full-stack work end-to-end: API → data model → UI
  • Mentoring L2 engineers and leading technical design discussions
  • Contributing to architectural decisions across the monolith and SPA
  • Sharing on-call duties and helping evolve engineering standards


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years full-stack experience, with deep Rails + modern React fluency
  • A track record of owning complex features from design through production
  • Advanced SQL and a genuinely analytical, evidence-led mindset
  • Proven ability to mentor and influence technical direction
  • Excellent async communication — this is a fully distributed team
  • Real excitement about mission-driven work


Bonus Points

  • Healthcare tech, social services, or other practitioner-facing domains
  • Multi-tenant data models, RBAC, accessibility-aware UI
  • Experience scaling a Rails monolith with a React SPA frontend


Interested? Apply here or message me directly - happy to walk you through the role, the team, and the mission before you commit to a full process.

title: Editor de imagens
description:
A Bia Marchione Fotógrafa está em busca de um(a) Editor(a) de Fotografia para atuar de forma remota/home office em projetos de casamentos, pré-weddings e eventos sociais.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência em Lightroom Classic , tratamento de cor, ajustes de exposição, contraste, balanço de branco, pele e padronização estética.

O trabalho envolve edição de imagens em volume, seguindo a identidade visual da marca e mantendo consistência entre diferentes ambientes de luz, como making of, cerimônia, ensaio do casal, recepção e flash.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com edição de fotografia.
  • Domínio de Lightroom Classic.
  • Familiaridade com arquivos RAW.
  • Atenção à cor, pele, luz e consistência visual.
  • Organização para trabalhar remotamente.
  • Compromisso com prazos.
  • Abertura para receber feedback.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com fotografia de casamento.
  • Conhecimento em Photoshop.
  • Experiência com catálogos do Lightroom.
  • Portfólio com antes/depois.

A vaga é remota , com contratação por projeto e possibilidade de recorrência.

  • Interessados devem enviar portfólio, experiência, disponibilidade e forma de cobrança.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados que vá além de números — alguém capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar decisões que impactam diretamente o crescimento do negócio.

Se você tem olhar analítico, curiosidade e gosta de encontrar padrões onde outros veem apenas dados, essa oportunidade é para você.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Coletar, organizar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes

Criar dashboards e relatórios para acompanhamento de performance

Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria

Apoiar equipes de marketing, produto e negócios com insights acionáveis

Monitorar KPIs e sugerir otimizações baseadas em dados

Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados garantindo qualidade e consistência

Automatizar processos e relatórios sempre que possível

REQUISITOS

Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados ou função similar

Forte habilidade analítica e raciocínio lógico

Conhecimento em ferramentas como Excel/Google Sheets, SQL e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Noções de estatística e interpretação de dados

Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights claros e objetivos

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados

Conhecimento em Google Analytics, BigQuery ou ferramentas de tracking

Experiência em ambientes de marketing ou produto

BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração compatível com o mercado

Bônus por desempenho (conforme política da empresa)

Ambiente colaborativo, orientado a dados e inovação

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks & Azure)
description:
Role: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks & Azure)

Location: Remote (Brazil, Mexico, or Costa Rica)

Type: Contract


Role Summary

We are looking for a Developer Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise You will work hands on with Python PySpark Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Git based workflows and CICD and support end-to-end delivery through Azure DevOps


Key Responsibilities

  • Design develop and optimize ETLELT pipelines using Databricks PySpark to ingest transform and serve data for digital customer experience use cases
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration performance tuning and cost awareness
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards
  • Build and maintain CICD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation checks monitoring and operational runbooks
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design mentor engineers drive standards for CICD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines


Primary Skills Must Have

• Strong hands on experience with

  • Python
  • PySpark
  • Databricks jobs workflows clusters repos
  • SQL advanced querying optimization

• Strong experience with Git and repository platforms GitHub andor Bitbucket

• Handson experience implementing CICD for data engineering workloads

• Strong working experience with Azure DevOps Boards Repos Pipelines build release workflows


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

• Azure Data Factory ADF for orchestration ingestion and scheduling patterns

• Power BI experience for consumption layer understanding datasets measures refresh patterns supporting analytics enablement


Apply or share your resume to

Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um Senior Databricks Engineer com experiência na construção de pipelines e desenvolvimento de processos ETL no Databricks para agregar ao nosso Databricks CoE. Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel essencial na interseção entre negócios e tecnologia, combinando profundo conhecimento técnico com a capacidade de alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • 5+ anos de experiência com manipulação e engenharia de dados
  • 5+ anos com processos ETL
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Databricks
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Azure
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe
  • Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;

Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Vivência em projetos internacionais e equipes multiculturais
  • Experiência com Power BI e integração entre engenharia e BI
  • Curiosidade e desejo de se envolver em diferentes etapas do ciclo de dados (desde ingestão até visualização)

Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

Modalidade De Contratação

  • CLT ou PJ.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.


Apply Here:
